architecture: MLP on a one-hot 80-nucleotide window: 320 -> 128 relu -> 32 relu -> 2
window: 80 nucleotides of the gene's sense (transcribed) strand, 5' to 3', positions 0..79; the candidate dinucleotide (GT or AG) is at positions 40 and 41
encoding: input index = 4 * p + b for position p = 0..79 and base b in the order A, C, G, T (one-hot; no held-out window contains another letter)
donor: a real donor window has the intron's first two bases GT at 40-41: positions 0..39 are the 40 bases before the junction (position 39 is exon position -1; when the exon is shorter than 40 bases, the window reaches back into the intron before it), positions 42..79 are intron positions +3 .. +40 (or beyond the intron's end when the intron is shorter)
acceptor: a real acceptor window has the intron's last two bases AG at 40-41: positions 0..39 are the 40 bases before them (position 39 is intron position -3; when the intron is shorter, the window reaches back into the exon before it), positions 42..79 are the 38 bases after the junction (position 42 is exon position +1; when the exon is shorter, the window runs on into the next intron)
decoys: a decoy is a GT or AG at positions 40-41 inside the pre-mRNA of the same set of genes (exon or intron), at least 100 nucleotides from every splice site annotated in any GENCODE basic transcript, on the sense strand
decoy_matching: Decoys were drawn so that their agreement with the textbook consensus has exactly the same distribution as the real sites'. GT windows: the number of the 7 positions 37, 38, 39, 42, 43, 44, 45 (donor -3, -2, -1, +3, +4, +5, +6) that match M A G | G T R A G T (M = A or C, R = A or G). AG windows: the number of pyrimidines (C, T) at positions 27..38 (acceptor -15 .. -4), plus one if position 39 (-3) is C or T, plus one if position 42 (exon +1) is G. For every value of that count there are as many decoys as real sites, so the count alone cannot tell them apart.
held_out: 8,000 windows: 2,000 real donors, 2,000 real acceptors, 2,000 GT decoys and 2,000 AG decoys, from chromosomes 1, 7, 13 and 19 (genes on other chromosomes were used to train the reference)
dataset_facts: Human genome GRCh38 (UCSC hg38) and GENCODE release 46 basic annotation. Real sites are the introns of the Ensembl canonical transcript of every protein-coding gene (chromosomes 1-22 and X) whose intron starts with GT and ends with AG; each site once. Real donors and acceptors were drawn at random from those on the held-out chromosomes.
forward: x = the 320 one-hot values; h1 = relu(fc1.weight @ x + fc1.bias); h2 = relu(fc2.weight @ h1 + fc2.bias); logits = fc3.weight @ h2 + fc3.bias; the prediction is the argmax (logits within 1e-9 x max(1, |max logit|) of the maximum count as tied; ties go to the lowest index)
metric: accuracy on the 8,000 held-out windows (half real, half decoy)
